title: The Feathered Adventure
moral: Friendship and teamwork make adventures joyful and meaningful.

scenes.summary: Felix finds a mysterious blue feather near the river.

story: Felix the fox found a shiny blue feather near the river and wondered where it came from. He asked his friends Tilly the turtle and Benny the bunny to help him. Together they explored the forest and met a wise owl who told them to follow the stream. They followed the path and found a magical Bluebird who had lost the feather. The Bluebird thanked them and sang a beautiful song. She gave them sparkling feathers as a gift. Felix and his friends returned home happy, proud, and full of joy from their adventure together.
